scope: Unloaded structural display and aerodynamic-load transfer clarity
diagnosis: The original study contains no custom force, no self-weight, and no applied panel-load record. Aerodynamic settings alone do not apply a structural load. All static response fields are correctly zero.
changes: Neutral structural model and prominent no-load notice instead of a fabricated 0 to 1 MPa stress contour and zero extrema markers.
Direct actions open Aerodynamics or structural load setup. Solved aerodynamic fields without a transferred load are labelled Solved / not applied.
Constant fields retain their exact value; unresolved samples are distinct from zero. PNG exports omit unloaded colour bars and false extrema.
Opening a saved study clears the previous aerodynamic result and admission display while preserving the imported applied-load record; imports wait for an active solver to finish.

checks.test_zero_load_display.cjs: passed, actual renderer/legend/import functions with Three.js r128
checks.test_unapplied_aero_load.cjs: passed, fresh eight-mesh panel solve, structural admission and v4 reload
checks.browserQA: Local Chromium: imported original JSON, solved unloaded structure, observed neutral no-load notice, opened Aerodynamics from the notice, solved the actual panel sequence, applied its loads, observed a nonzero mirrored stress contour, and reloaded the applied state successfully.

limitations: Nominal one-way potential-flow panel and linear spatial-beam analysis. Numerical admission is not experimental validation, local solid stress or failure certification. Sampled section envelopes and rendered surface-vertex extrema have different sampling coverage.
